alerts.message: CRITICAL SIF HAZARD: Loose scaffolding planks at Unit 3 at Sector 2 Elevation Deck
recommendations: Red-tag scaffolding and suspend elevated work until re-certified (OSHA 1926.451).
Secure all loose scaffolding planks with certified locking pins and clamps.
Enforce 100% tie-off using dual self-retracting lifelines (SRLs) anchored to tested points.
alerts.explanation: Loose scaffolding planks at elevation create an immediate high-severity SIF fall hazard.

alerts.message: CRITICAL SIF HAZARD: Corroded flange line steam leak at Sector 4 North, Tank Farm
recommendations: Isolate upstream line valves and depressurize affected steam pipe section immediately.
Deploy thermal splash blast shields and verify flange bolt torques per ASME B16.5.
Replace corroded gasket with high-temp spiral-wound metallic gasket under hot-work permit.
alerts.explanation: High-pressure steam flange leakage poses thermal scald and piping failure hazards.

alerts.reportTitle: V-204 Hydrocracker – Radial vibration anomaly on bearing
alerts.message: HIGH RISK TELEMETRY: 4.8 mm/s radial vibration spike on Hydrocracker Pump C.
recommendations: Initiate controlled operational throttling/shutdown of unit to prevent catastrophic bearing seizure.
Conduct spectrum vibration FFT analysis and laser shaft alignment on bearing housing.
Inspect lubrication reservoir for metal particulates and replace degraded bearings under LOTO.
alerts.explanation: Excessive vibration exceeds baseline threshold. Immediate balancing and bearing inspection required.
